beschreibung: The entry Gruben is listed in the Café category for the Außerfern region in Tyrol. In the existing record, the establishment is described as a cosy café that aims to impress with select coffee specialities, homemade cakes and tarts as well as small snacks. An inviting, lovingly furnished atmosphere and its suitability for a relaxed break with coffee and cake are highlighted. A clear assignment of the establishment within Tyrol was not possible on the basis of the coordinates provided, which is why the details on location, address and contact remain open. The Außerfern is the westernmost district of Tyrol around Reutte and includes, among others, the Lechtal, the Tannheimertal and the Zugspitze region. The region is known for its mountain landscape, its hiking trails and its proximity to the Allgäu, and is a popular destination for nature lovers.
